title: Slowen Lo
description: Slowen Lo, an Abednedo entrepreneur and proud citizen of Canto Bight, could not allow poorly parked speeders. When Finn and Rose parked their speeder on the beach, he tried to warn them it belonged in a proper berth at the spaceport, but they just wouldn't listen. That's when he had to get the police of Canto Bight involved to serve justice to the shuttle parkers.
